objective: second-domain falsification of regime adaptation and causal cross-domain model selection

new_real_domain.name: lithium-ion battery pack price
new_real_domain.source: NREL H2 2020 Solar Industry Update / BNEF 2020 survey
new_real_domain.vintage_status: retrospective series published 2021; NOT historical-vintage clean

falsification: The sequencing-specific surprise/adaptation rule does not generalize to battery prices: adaptive MALE is 31.3% worse than all-history on the six held-out battery points. This negative result is retained.
new_method: causal_model_selector chooses among all-history and rolling windows using only candidate errors observed before the target; final-outcome perturbation test verifies choice cannot depend on current target.
reason: both dense sequencing and battery numerical series are retrospective transcriptions; dated source availability is explicit and blocks false strict replay
